cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Approve the Harmless Version
cards.instruction: Get approval for a harmless version of your plan, then gradually reveal what that approval now commits them to.

mechanism: A takes charge of hosting by getting assent to two guests, then trades extra work for B accepting the larger commitment.
confusable: A straightforward large invitation lacks the small prior consent that A keeps expanding while preserving B cooperation.
comparison: Unlike committee membership, the pressure is domestic hosting capacity and division of cooking.
seedUse: Tea seed provides the incremental guest reveal; S02 leadership becomes changing serving arrangements to retain cohost agreement.
